[[File:Francesca.png|thumb|250px|Francesca]] '''Francesca''' (Japanese: '''シズエ''' ''Shizue'') is a Pokémon Magician and a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP070|The Bells Are Singing!]]''. Francesca performs with three {{p|Chingling}}. One of them, wearing a green ribbon, seemed to have a little more personality than the other two, being very energetic. It loved to meet new people and would hug them. Francesca tried to use it in a {{pkmn|battle}} against [[Ash's Turtwig]] in order to discipline it, but it was weak. Her training exercises were very difficult, even though she was dealing with small Pokémon. After {{TRT}} kidnapped her three Chingling, [[James]] grew fond of the Chingling wearing the green ribbon, as it reminded him of his {{TP|James|Chimecho}}. Later on, Francesca gained more confidence in Chingling and used it to defeat James and {{TP|James|Mime Jr.}} ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Francesca |pkmn=Chingling (×3) |type1=Psychic |img=Francesca Chingling.png |cap=Francesca's Chingling |epnum=DP070 |epname=The Bells Are Singing |vajp=Tomoko Kawakami |vajp2=List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Masako Jo |vajp3=List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Hinako Sasaki |vaen=Michele Knotz |desc=Francesca's three Chingling perform in her magic shows, adding their harmonic tones and cute charm to the acts. The Chingling each wear a differently colored ribbon to differentiate one from the others. The Chingling with the green ribbon was particularly friendly and tended to interrupt Francesca's performances. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} decided to have a battle against this Chingling to help it mature; Francesca, having never battled before, agreed. Chingling was told to use Astonish, but it didn't attack. [[Ash's Turtwig]] used {{m|Razor Leaf}}, which knocked it out instantly. Later, [[James]] was drawn to this Chingling and took it for himself. After [[James's Mime Jr.]] used {{m|Teeter Dance}}, Chingling became {{status|Confusion|confused}} and attacked Mime Jr. with two different attacks. The group believed the battle had matured Chingling, though it still asked them for a hug afterwards. The green ribbon Chingling's known moves are {{m|Astonish}}, {{m|Hidden Power}}, and {{m|Confusion}}; the other two's moves are unknown.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Francesca |pkmn=Pidgey |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Francesca Pidgey.png |epnum=DP070 |epname=The Bells Are Singing |desc=Not much is known about Francesca's {{p|Pidgey}}, as it was only seen during one of her magic tricks.
